checks: Deriver (hand, T^(2) with auxiliary mass) and checker (toolkit uv_pole + own Feynman-parameter extractor) agree on N_0 for every diagram and in total.

Referee recomputation by Feynman parameters with split metrics: fermion bubble int 2 kbar.(kbar+pbar)/(k^2(k+p)^2) has pole (i/(16pi^2 eps)) (-pbar^2 - 2/3 phat^2); gauge bubble int (2p+k)^2/(k^2((k+p)^2-m^2)) has pole (i/(16pi^2 eps)) (2p^2 + m^2); quartic tadpole 6 lambda m^2; seagull scaleless.
Vertex rules, loop signs, symmetry factors and group factors re-derived (H_j/H^dag_i momentum routing, eps_li eps_lj = delta_ij, (delta delta + delta delta) delta = 3 delta).

P N_0 = anticommuting-gamma5 result; m_0^2 = m^2[1 + (6 lambda + Ycal - 3 C_H)/(16 pi^2 eps)] gives 16 pi^2 dm^2/dln mu = m^2 (12 lambda + 2 Ycal - 9/2 g^2 - 3/2 g'^2) (targets section 3, Machacek-Vaughn).

delta Z_H = (2 C_H - Ycal)/(16 pi^2 eps) equals targets section 3; Gamma_div = kappa{-2C_H (DH)^dag DH + Ycal (Dbar H)^dag Dbar H + 2/3 Ycal (dhat H)^dag dhat H} two-point part equals targets section 2.1 (BIMS (5.9)).
Diagram list: 8 multiplet-level diagrams (26 component diagrams) as in ENUMERATION.md; no gluon, no ghost diagrams.

Evanescent split cross-check: with c(E_H) = -(2/3) Ycal/(16pi^2 eps) in delta S, -b_d delta S gives the vertex function (2/3) Ycal kappa i T^a_H (phat_Hdag^2 - phat_H^2), identical to the pole found by the g1_cSS_cSSV checker (check_cSS_output.json: (2i/3) Ycal (p2h^2 - p1h^2), p1 on H, p2 on H^dag).
caveats: Feynman gauge; delta Z_H and the -C_H m^2 term are gauge dependent, m_0^2 is not.
Q_SS and Q_m are four-dimensional monomials in 03b; here their d-dimensional continuations (as in S_0) are used, with the hatted parts carried by tilde(E)_H and E_H.

The two-point function alone fixes only c(E_H) - c(tilde(E)_H) = -(1/3) Ycal (Gamma units); the split c(tilde E_H) : c(E_H) = Ycal : (2/3) Ycal is taken from g0_SSV_SSVV (deriver result) and is confirmed by the g1_cSS_cSSV checker pole.
